issues.detail: The Greek 'λαβειν' (labein) is an infinitive of purpose/result, meaning 'to take' or 'to receive'. The Vietnamese translation 'để từ đó lấy ra... dâng cho' (in order to take out... offer to) adds a secondary action ('dâng cho' - to offer/dedicate) that is not present in the Greek text. The Greek simply says 'to take a people from the nations for His name'.
